scenicChapters.title: Izu Skyline and Jogasaki Coast checkpoint 8 → Izu Skyline and Jogasaki
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 63 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

tokyo-kanto-rides-izu-skyline-and-jogasa.story: A 146 km one-way ride from near Kawasaki, about 2 h 55 of riding. The climbs: near Kisarazu and Scenic stretch near Honchō. Long stretches are under trees.
